title: Taiwan clears initial funding to launch homegrown Albatross II drone production
html: Taiwan's domestically developed Albatross II military drone has cleared a major funding hurdle, paving the way for initial production after the Legislative Yuan approved NT$1.675 billion (US$50.96 million) in first-year funding under the central government's...
